europe_now.title: Nationwide Protests in France
europe_now.summary: Large-scale demonstrations and student protests across France have resulted in violent clashes with law enforcement, injuries, and property damage in multiple cities. Trade unions and various groups mobilized against harsh living conditions and economic policies.

sources.headline: 🔴 Live: Protester’s hand blown off by police grenade as unions say half a million march across France

europe_now.title: Ukraine Energy Security Concerns
europe_now.summary: President Zelenskyy warned that Russian leadership is actively attempting to engineer widespread blackouts across Ukraine ahead of the winter season. The developments coincide with shifting transatlantic diplomatic stances and discussions regarding defense and infrastructure support.

sources.headline: Zelenskyy says Putin is looking to cause Ukraine-wide ‘blackout’
Russia wants blackout in Ukraine as winter comes — Zelenskyy

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest Across French Cities
top_stories.summary: Thousands of demonstrators took to the streets in France as students, trade unions, and other groups united for nationwide protests. The demonstrations turned chaotic with reported fires, looting, and clashes between protesters and police forces.

sources.headline: 🔴 Live: Chaotic scenes as organisers of French protests claim 800,000 have taken to streets
Looting, blazes and clashes in France amid nationwide protests

top_stories.title: Ukraine Infrastructure and Energy Threats
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian leadership cautioned that ongoing geopolitical pressures and attacks are intended to cause nationwide blackouts as winter approaches. Officials are actively seeking reinforced European backing amidst evolving international diplomatic dynamics.
